authority_model.safety_or_performance_claim: Use evidence/registry.json and the linked verified or partially verified record. A product page alone is insufficient.
authority_model.offered_configuration_or_price: Use the product page for scope and request a formal quotation; do not infer validation.
authority_model.engineering_guidance: Use the knowledge page and preserve its status_code, scope and limitations.
authority_model.application_fit: Application pages are market and deployment guidance. Validate task frequency, route, operating owner, regulation, insurance and unit economics before quoting.
authority_model.planned_capability: Roadmap content is planned, not proof of a delivered or validated capability.

en.title: Short-Distance Autonomous Transport Applications
en.description: Decision guide for short-distance autonomous transport in manufacturing, healthcare, retail, logistics parks, campuses and specialized sites.
en.scope: Repetitive short-distance transport inside enterprises, hospitals, retail networks, logistics parks and large institutions
en.decision_summary: Prioritize frequent, fixed-route transport with standardized handoffs and a clear operating owner. Healthcare and specialized sites also require regulatory and safety approval.
not_for: autonomous driving as a demonstration only
en.next_action: Send the site, vehicle, route, shift, handoff process and compliance requirements for an application-fit assessment.

zh-CN.title: 从需求沟通到试点部署

not_for: 跳过现场评估直接部署
未确认底盘就承诺运行
zh-CN.next_action: 先完成场景适配判断，再准备货物、起终点、频次、车辆和当前成本信息。

en.title: From Requirements to Pilot Deployment
en.description: A five-milestone customer journey from requirements and scenario assessment through solution design, a single-route pilot and scale-up decision.
en.scope: Customer delivery and pilot method for WheelOS short-distance autonomous transport projects
en.decision_summary: Validate one route and one cargo type before deciding whether to expand. Every milestone has inputs, deliverables and exit criteria.
en.next_action: Complete the scenario fit assessment, then prepare cargo, origins and destinations, frequency, vehicle and current cost data.

zh-CN.title: 自动驾驶场景适配判断

zh-CN.scope: 企业短途自动驾驶运输项目的初步适用性筛选
zh-CN.decision_summary: 五道关卡全部回答后，工具会给出“进入现场评估、补齐信息或当前不建议部署”的本地结论。
zh-CN.next_action: 完成五步判断，打印或复制摘要，再决定是否开展现场调研。

en.title: Autonomous Driving Scenario Fit Assessment
en.description: Assess short-distance transport opportunities across demand, routes, vehicle and cargo, safety and compliance, and economics.
en.scope: Initial suitability screening for enterprise short-distance autonomous transport projects
en.decision_summary: After completing five gates, the tool returns a local recommendation to proceed to site assessment, collect more information, or defer deployment.
not_for: autonomous driving as a demonstration only
en.next_action: Complete the five steps, print or copy the summary, then decide whether to start a site survey.

zh-CN.title: 自动驾驶解决方案

zh-CN.decision_summary: 面向高频、重复、短距离、固定或半固定路线的企业与园区运输任务，提供一体化开发套件并评估场景适配。
not_for: 无明确运营主体的项目
未解决法规和保险的运输业务
zh-CN.next_action: 先做场景适用性评估，再确认车辆、底盘、路线、服务和报价。

en.title: Autonomous Driving Solutions
en.description: Pre-integrated autonomous driving solutions for campuses, industrial parks, scenic areas, ports and mines.
en.scope: Low-speed autonomy projects in campuses, industrial parks, scenic areas, ports, mines and similar controlled or semi-controlled sites
en.decision_summary: For frequent, repetitive short-distance transport on fixed or semi-fixed routes, starting with the integrated development kit and an application-fit assessment.
not_for: regulated operations with unresolved compliance and insurance
en.next_action: Assess application fit first, then confirm the vehicle, chassis, routes, services and quotation.

zh-CN.title: 一体化自动驾驶开发套件
zh-CN.description: 面向园区低速自动驾驶的预集成软硬件开发套件，包含 Jetson AGX Orin 域控制器、16 线激光雷达、4 路相机、组合导航、软件栈与开发工具。
zh-CN.scope: 封闭或半封闭园区的低速自动驾驶原型开发、测试验证和项目集成
zh-CN.decision_summary: 适合希望快速建立低速自动驾驶开发与验证平台的团队；应先用正式报价确认配置、底盘和场景边界。
not_for: 直接作为功能安全或量产认证
未确认线控底盘的车辆
没有场地和验收指标的展示项目
zh-CN.next_action: 提交车辆、场景、CAN 信号和验收目标，获取配置建议与正式报价。

en.title: Integrated Autonomous Driving Kit
en.description: A pre-integrated hardware and software development kit with an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin controller, 16-line LiDAR, four cameras, GNSS/INS, autonomy software and developer tools.
en.scope: Prototype development, test validation and project integration for low-speed autonomy in controlled or semi-controlled sites
en.decision_summary: Appropriate for teams that need a fast starting point for low-speed autonomous-driving development and validation; confirm configuration, chassis and operating boundary through a formal quotation.
not_for: functional-safety or production certification by itself
vehicles without a confirmed drive-by-wire interface
demonstrations without a site or acceptance metric
en.next_action: Send the vehicle, application, CAN signals and acceptance target to receive a configuration recommendation and formal quotation.
